fact: Ratoma's delegated civil-registry officer Amadou Konia Camara says secure digital paper is used to issue digital birth certificates in all communes of Guinea, and that registrations continue despite a two-week paper stockout.
ONECI and NG Tech Innovation signed an MoU on 24 July 2026 on the digital transformation of identification and civil status services in Guinea, as reported by Mediaguinee.

The MATD minister told the CNT commission that, through ONECI, it is digitising civil status and setting up the Registre national de l'Etat civil, with digital solutions deployed in 28 communes in 2025.
MATD, through ONECI, launched the RENEC national civil-status register project on 28 October 2026 to digitalise civil registration, with first centres in 2026 and the project running to 2028.

L'Independant quotes the head of the elections directorate saying authorities set up the national civil register (RAVEC) as part of a digitalisation and modernisation of civil registration, while birth registration remains low and deaths are declared at only about 2%.

Planete 7 reports Enabel and the EU handed the interior ministry (MATD) equipment, source code and database access for the pilot civil registration digitalisation project, which reached 10 pilot communes and extends to 28 communes, 11 courts and 5 consulates.
